prepareInstallation.description: A recipe (see script/Recipes.sol). It names its own components by their index in the components list.

components.name: components
components.description: Components to clone, initialized in this order with the installing DAO, their dependencies and their settings. The first one is the flow's budget.

components.name: id
components.description: Registry id, e.g. "OpenFillAction@1".

components.name: deps
components.description: Indexes of the earlier components it depends on, in the order its metadata lists them.

components.name: settings
components.description: Its settings, ABI-encoded as its metadata lists them.

components.name: nodes
components.description: The tree. Node 0 is the root.

components.name: action
components.description: Index of an Action component, or type(uint256).max for a branch without an action.

components.name: children
components.description: Indexes of the child nodes, each greater than this node's.

components.name: splitter
components.description: Index of a Splitter component that divides the output among the children when there are 2+ (a WeightSplitter for fixed weights), or type(uint256).max otherwise.

components.name: skipWhenEmpty
components.description: Skip this node and everything below it when it receives 0, instead of reverting. Never on the root.

components.name: forwardSurplus
components.description: Give the children everything that arrived, not just the declared output. Off by default: anything above it stays in the DAO. Only on a node with an action and children. With one token, what arrived is the input plus the net change.

components.name: grants
components.description: Permissions to grant, beyond EXECUTE and CONFIGURE which the setup always grants. Each may only target the plugin or one of the recipe's components.

components.name: where
components.description: The plugin or a component.

components.name: kind
components.description: 0 Account, 1 Dao (the installing DAO), 2 Plugin, 3 Component.

components.name: account
components.description: The address, for an Account.

components.name: index
components.description: The recipe index, for a Component.

components.name: who
components.description: An account, the DAO, the plugin or a component.

components.name: kind
components.description: 0 Account, 1 Dao (the installing DAO), 2 Plugin, 3 Component.

components.name: account
components.description: The address, for an Account.

components.name: index
components.description: The recipe index, for a Component.

components.name: permissionId
components.description: Any permission but CONFIGURE_PERMISSION_ID.

prepareUninstallation.description: The recipe's grants, exactly as installed. They are checked against a hash stored at installation.
